subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining LINE/no-grouping media burst behavior become a LINE plugin media-batching feature with a user-facing delay key, or should OpenClaw limit batching to channel-native groups and narrower bug fixes?
rationale: The fix changes channel delivery timing and likely adds a public config/default surface, and LINE lacks native grouping metadata, so automation should not choose the product semantics alone.

options.title: Add LINE-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an optional LINE plugin buffer keyed by account, conversation, and sender, with conservative defaults and tests for timer/text flush behavior.

options.title: Use a shared media debounce seam
options.body: Extend shared inbound debounce to support media-aware batching across channels, accepting broader compatibility and owner-boundary risk.

options.title: Document current limitation
options.body: Keep only Telegram native media groups and narrow WhatsApp fixes, and document that LINE rapid media bursts are processed one event at a time.

recommendation.title: Add LINE-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an optional LINE plugin buffer keyed by account, conversation, and sender, with conservative defaults and tests for timer/text flush behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining actionable code path is in LINE plugin handler/context/config files where prior history points to this handle as a recent contributor.
